config.name: SYSTEM-I-PARENT-BALANCED-CANDIDATES
config.parent_source: TOP 10 unique version_ids from SYSTEM-A fused ranking (ChatGPT option B)
config.local_bm25_implementation: experiments/EXP-018B/scripts/local_bm25_batched.py Track-1 batched IDF; scoring semantics identical to per-parent lexical_search
config.L_means: ADDITIVE LOCAL PASSAGES PER QUERY after dedupe excluding A-pool-100
config.P_means: additive canonical extras after excluding C_E, ordered by best projection fused DESC then chunk_id ASC
config.union: C_E UNION C_P; C_E = A pool-100 UNION selected L=10 extras; C_P = first 20 previously absent canonical chunks from projection mapping; never drop C_E
config.merge_rrf: rrf_fuse_labelled k=60 over system_a + local_bm25:<version_id> filtered to (in A-pool-100) OR (selected L extras); keep original within-parent BM25 ranks 1..W; top_k=union size. Projection is NOT a third merge-RRF list.
config.cross_parent_order: among extras not in A-pool-100, after dedupe: round(local_BM25_score numeric 9) DESC, then chunk_id ASC
config.a_channel: E-L10 merge-RRF a_norm kept exactly; projection-only a_norm=minmax(projection-RRF) over the P extras for that query (MINMAX_DEGENERATE=0.5 if hi==lo). Two-population minmax inherited from EXP-019A; combined list is NOT re-minmaxed.
config.a_norm_C_E: keep E-L10 a_norm exactly as computed on the E-L10 pool
config.a_norm_C_P_only: minmax_norm over the P projection-only fused scores for that query; MINMAX_DEGENERATE=0.5 if constant. Replaces SYSTEM-F a_norm=0.0.
config.ce_norm: minmax over C (union); kept exactly from EXP-017 stored values (not re-minmaxed because a_norm changed)
config.ce_constructor: CrossEncoderReranker(pad='batch', bucket_by_length=True)  # D1; not fast=True; threads default 4
config.tie_break: blend DESC, E-L10 merge-RRF rank (C_P-only a_rank=10**9 after those with RRF ranks), chunk_id ASC
config.one_change_from_F: projection-only retrieval_norm = minmax(projection-RRF over P extras); E-L10 a_norm and EXP-017 CE minmax kept exactly; blend 0.7/0.3
config.ce_bucket_rule: sort by unpadded token length then original index; unpermute logits to original order
config.one_change_from_G: D1 CE padding/bucketing only; ranking semantics identical to SYSTEM-G
config.one_change_from_G_CE_D1: identity freeze of the PERF-003 D1 V2 path as the development architecture candidate; no ranking/quality change
config.one_change_from_H: additive parent-balanced within-document candidate generation only: for each exact SYSTEM-H parent version_id, UNION the top-1 canonical local-BM25 candidate (existing E-L10 local-BM25 semantics) and the top-1 unique canonical from existing EXP-017 map_to_canonical_extras ranking over globally scored projection_rrf hits restricted to that parent; dedupe by chunk_id; never drop a SYSTEM-H union member. L=10 P=20 W=20 PARENT_N=10 unchanged. No CE, no blend, no coverage selector, no MMR, no final top10.
config.parent_balanced_bm25: TOP 1 canonical per SYSTEM-H parent from the same local_bm25_per_parent_batched lists used by E-L10 (cs_v1_control, full-corpus IDF, tokenizer query_terms, ORDER BY round(score numeric 9) DESC, chunk_id ASC). Does not alter L=10 extras.
config.parent_balanced_projection: Restrict existing globally scored projection_rrf hits to version_id==parent; apply exact map_to_canonical_extras unique-canonical ranking (every covering_chunk_id receives that projection fused score; max wins; sort (-best_fused, chunk_id ASC)); take k=1. Does not alter global P=20. Does not recompute parent-local BM25/dense/RRF ranks. Does not invent an overlap heuristic among covering chunks of one projection.
config.parent_balanced_union: SYSTEM-H existing union (C_E UNION C_P) UNION parent-balanced BM25 UNION parent-balanced projection; dedupe canonical chunk_id; never remove SYSTEM-H candidate. Max <=20 extra canonicals before dedup (1 BM25 + 1 projection per parent; PARENT_N=10 cap).
config.parent_set: exact SYSTEM-H parent_version_ids: unique version_ids among SYSTEM-A fused top-10 hits, capped at PARENT_N=10 (existing system_e.parent_version_ids). Reuse stored EVAL-NATQ-VAL-001 parent lists after identical recomputation check.
config.multi_cover_mapping_resolution: Existing map_to_canonical_extras already emits ALL covering_chunk_ids from each projection result into a unique-canonical score table. Corpus: 12687/18057 projections have covering_n>1 (max 24). EXP-020A does not take 'one projection then emit all covers'; it takes the existing unique-canonical ranking with k=1 per parent. This reuses the frozen mapping rule rather than inventing a new one.
